  • Ability to communicate optimization strategies and analytical insights to both technical and business audiences
  • Familiarity with scalable cloud environments and distributed systems
  • Nice to have: experience with scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, NumPy, Spark, Databricks, UI prototyping tools (Flask, Plotly, Streamlit), and CI/CD or modern DevOps workflows

Benefits

  • Referral program and professional development opportunities
  • Opportunity to work on high-impact optimization and AI/ML projects in retail and CPG

  • Collaborate directly with CEO, CTO, engineers, and clients to turn business needs into technical solutions

  • Architecture: Monorepo (nx) evolving into Microfrontends using Module Federation

Backend

  • Languages/Frameworks: Node.js, NestJS
  • Permissions & Policy: Cerbos

Edge

  • Cloudflare
  • AWS/Akamai
  • Vercel
  • We work with a lot and will be adapting most of existing edge computing providers

Mobile

3rd-Party Integrations

  • Stripe, Sentry, Google Analytics, Microsoft Clarity, Auth0

Cloud & DevOps

  • Version Control: GitHub

  • Tooling: infrastructure as code, Terraform, SAM, etc.
  • Proven experience as a Software/Solution Architect or in a similar technical leadership role
  • Strong understanding of software engineering principles and modern architectural patterns
  • Solid understanding of Microservices, Module Federation, composable architecture and distributed BASE systems
  • Experience with cloud platforms and edge computing (AWS, Cloudflare, Netlify) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Solid understanding of frontend and backend technologies
  • Experience integrating 3rd-party services, APIs, DevOps practices and tools
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience in startups or fast-paced environments is a plus

title: Sales Director
description:
Overview

Req ID:
Remote Position: Yes
Region: Americas
Country: USA

General Overview

Celestica is dedicated to delivering end-to-end product lifecycle solutions to drive our customers' success. Our growing Aerospace and Defense organization focuses on applying Celestica's advanced capabilities, knowledgeable people and innovative tools to enable companies in the A&D industry with highly complex, mission critical applications to improve their competitive advantage.

We are looking for a Sales Director who is passionate and results-oriented to be part of our global A&D organization. If you are a highly motivated individual who can align unique insights to key customer priorities and can engage customers by deliberately linking their business priorities to our value propositions, then we want you on our team.

Detailed Description

As the Sales Director, you will be responsible for targeting new customer engagements across various submarkets in the Aerospace and Defense (A&D) space.

The incumbent is accountable to:
  • Develop strong and long-lasting insight-based relationships with our customers and identify mobilizers. The incumbent will act as the primary sales interface for several accounts on a regional basis. More specifically:
  • Investigates potential new opportunities within the account
  • Identify, develop new accounts in North American region
  • Gains competitive intelligence and always ties insights back to our unique strengths in the market
  • Creates opportunities to provide a unique and contrarian perspective during commercial conversations and is able to reframe the way customers view their business
  • Have deep knowledge of customer's business current macro and microeconomic trends, industry trends and potential new business opportunities
  • Engages the customer by deliberately tying their business priorities to our value proposition
  • Manages the overall customer relationship process while supporting business development in the planning and execution of the account strategies, tactics and selling propositions.
  • Acts as the Customer advocate to ensure that the organization remains customer-focused.
  • Acts as the main focal point to understand customers needs and requests, manages them and delivers business proposals and RFQ responses to customers.
  • Maintains a minimum revenue accountability (a personal sales quota)
  • Establishes value before ROI/financial terms. Is able to qualify and quantify the impact of maintaining the status quo or pursuing competitor's solutions.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies

  • Strong communication, interpersonal, relationship management and professional sales skills
  • Have the ability to work on, and close, multiple prospects simultaneously
  • Experience in high complex service selling within the Aerospace and Defense market segment
  • Understanding of technical and process fundamentals related to electronics and electromechanical products used in the A&D industry and associated compliance standards (AS9100, ITAR, DFAR, FAA)
  • Understanding of the A&D Product Development Process from Concept to Qualification
  • Proven track record of developing business with new clients / developing new markets led by a technical background (either in manufacturing or engineering)
  • Fostering and building relationships with existing clients as required
  • Strong strategic planning and execution skills
  • Ability to understand Profit and Loss modeling and sales impacts to improving customer financials
  • Value based consultative solution selling, business judgment, negotiation and decision-making skills.
  • Experience working and selling with senior level executives.
  • Experience working directly with customer Engineering, SCM and Manufacturing Teams in the co development of products, supply chain architecture and manufacturing process development.
  • Exceptional ability to work with others as part of a cross-functional team.
  • Experience working with vast remote cross-functional teams in large matrix organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to have successfully carried a sales, revenue or operational quota gains.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in business development and client relations specifically related to A&D products (strong network into the A&D industry is required)

Physical Demands

  • Duties of this position are performed in a normal office environment.
  • Duties may require extended periods of sitting and sustained visual concentration on a computer monitor or on numbers and other detailed data.
  • Repetitive manual movements (e.g., data entry, using a computer mouse, using a calculator, etc.) are frequently required.
  • Overnight travel may be required.

Typical Experience

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in business development and client relations specifically related to Aerospace & Defense. Preferred experience: 3 years experience selling in the EMS industry.
  • A strong network into the A&D industry is required

Typical Education

  • Bachelor's degree in related field, or consideration of an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Educational requirements may vary by geography.

Notes

This job description is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position. Employees are held accountable for all duties of the job. Job duties and the % of time identified for any function are subject to change at any time.

The salary range described in this posting is an estimate by the Company, and may change based on several factors, including by not limited to a change in the duties covered by the job posting, or the credentials, experience or geographic jurisdiction of the successful candidate.

Salary Range: $153-175k Annually

EEO and Location

Celestica is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, pregnancy, genetic information, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, and local laws. This policy applies to hiring, promotion, discharge, pay, fringe benefits, job training, classification, referral and other aspects of employment and also states that retaliation against a person who files a charge of discrimination, participates in a discrimination proceeding, or otherwise opposes an unlawful employment practice will not be tolerated. All information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines. Celestica is an E-Verify employer.

Location: This is a remote position, with travel as necessary. We are open to considering candidates close to any of our US locations in Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, Minnesota, Texas, Arizona, Oregon or California as well as locations near major airports such as the Northeast, Southeast, Midwest and Pacific Coast.

Company Overview

Celestica (NYSE, TSX: CLS) enables the world's best brands. Through our recognized customer-centric approach, we partner with leading companies in Aerospace and Defense, Communications, Enterprise, HealthTech, Industrial, Capital Equipment and Energy to deliver solutions for their most complex challenges. As a leader in design, manufacturing, hardware platform and supply chain solutions, Celestica brings global expertise and insight at every stage of product development - from drawing board to full-scale production and after-market services for products from advanced medical devices, to highly engineered aviation systems, to next-generation hardware platform solutions for the Cloud. Headquartered in Toronto, with talented teams spanning 40+ locations in 13 countries across the Americas, Europe and Asia, we imagine, develop and deliver a better future with our customers.

Celestica would like to thank all applicants, however, only qualified applicants will be contacted. Celestica does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies or fee based recruitment services.

title: Business Partner
description:
SOBRE A POSIÇÃO

Buscamos um(a) Business Partner para atuar como elo entre cliente, gerente de projetos, equipe técnica e gestão interna.

O foco é garantir que requisitos sejam corretamente levantados, documentados, validados e entregues, mantendo alinhamento entre escopo formalizado, expectativa do cliente e execução técnica.

Esse papel é essencial para assegurar previsibilidade, qualidade e alinhamento na execução dos projetos, evitando desvios de escopo e retrabalho.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES :

  • Levantar, especificar e documentar requisitos junto aos clientes, alinhados ao escopo e necessidades, de forma estruturada.
  • Formalizar requisitos e alinhar continuamente expectativa do cliente x escopo x execução técnica.
  • Participar de sprints e progress pulse junto ao time técnico, garantindo clareza sobre prioridades, status e bloqueios.
  • Validar internamente as entregas (homologação interna) frente aos requisitos levantados e ao escopo acordado.
  • Conduzir homologação externa com o cliente (apresentação e validação da entrega), sempre baseada no escopo, levantamento e especificação inicial.
  • Preparar formalizações de entregáveis e relatórios (com validação final do gerente).
  • Atuar como sentinela de escopo e qualidade: detectar e sinalizar desvios ao gerente de projetos.
  • Negociar prazos e expectativas em nível tático com clientes; conflitos de maior complexidade ou estratégicos são escalados ao gerente.
  • Garantir documentação de projeto (deck de gestão, cronograma macro, matriz de riscos, matriz de responsabilidades, status de backlog).
  • Consolidar dados de pipeline de projetos, prazos, throughput, retrabalho e CSAT.

INDICADORES DE SUCESSO (KPIs)

  • Qualidade e clareza dos requisitos levantados, refletida na ausência de gaps em homologação.
  • Percentual de entregas validadas sem retrabalho.
  • Percentual de entregas realizadas no prazo.
  • CSAT positivo dos clientes em relação ao processo de entrega e acompanhamento.
  • Projetos concluídos com documentação completa e aprovações formalizadas.

REQUISITOS

  • Experiência comprovada em levantamento, análise e especificação de requisitos.
  • Noções de negócio a partir da análise de dados.
  • Habilidade em comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Capacidade de negociação e gestão de conflitos em nível tático.
  • Experiência em projetos de tecnologia (preferencialmente SaaS) e conhecimento de processos de negócio.

DIFERENCIAIS

  • Conhecimento em planejamento e gestão de tarefas.
  • Conhecimento em Power BI ou ferramentas de visualização de dados.
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis.

MODELO DE TRABALHO

  • Regime : PJ.
  • Modalidade : Remoto, com encontros presenciais esporádicos em Campinas / SP ou São Paulo / SP.

WHY JOIN US

If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

About the role

We are looking for a Sales Engineering Delivery Manager with 3+ years of experience to connect prospective clients and internal teams. Strong knowledge of business strategy, the SDLC, and excellent communication skills are essential.

Technical Discovery Call & Stakeholder Engagement :

  • Lead the Technical Discovery call, showcasing outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly;
  • Demonstrate in-depth knowledge of the SDLC—from ideation and inception, through discovery and development, to market release—to guide discussions and identify project feasibility;
  • Use consultative questioning techniques to uncover client pain points and business objectives, extracting and analyzing high-level requirements such as project timeline, budget constraints, technical skill requirements, and risk assessments;
  • Showcase strong presentation and storytelling skills, ensuring clarity and persuasion in all client-facing interactions, both during calls and via emails.

Proposal Development & Deliverable Creation :

  • Develop dynamic, visually compelling presentation decks and engagement proposals that clearly articulate service offerings, project scope, value propositions, and strategic recommendations;
  • Customize deliverables to reflect client-specific challenges and opportunities uncovered during discovery meetings;
  • Integrate technical insights with business strategy, ensuring that proposals account for both immediate deliverables and long-term client growth.

Team Buildout and Project Kickoff :

  • Act as the primary point of coordination among Sales, Recruiting, and Engineering teams, ensuring smooth hand-offs from initial engagement through team buildout to project kick-off;
  • Serve as a “concierge” for deals, maintaining fluid communication and alignment across functions to drive successful client onboarding;
  • Serve as a trusted advisor during pre-sales engagements by translating complex technical aspects into digestible, business-focused narratives;
  • Maintain a sales / consulting mindset throughout the technical discovery process, ensuring proposals align with targeted business outcomes.

MUST HAVES

  • 3+ years of experience in similar Sales & Delivery Management roles;
  • Exceptional Communication & Soft Skills: outstanding interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and trust quickly; strong presentation and storytelling skills, ensuring clarity and persuasion in all client-facing interactions.
  • UX & Presentation Design Acumen: solid grasp of user experience (UX) principles and design thinking, enabling effective discussion of digital product experiences; proven track record of creating high-quality, visually engaging presentation decks and proposals.
  • Technical Savvy & SDLC Knowledge: a deep understanding of the software development lifecycle—from conceptualization through to market release—and familiarity with agile methodologies; capability to discuss technical nuances without losing sight of the business impact, bridging the gap between technical details and strategic outcomes.
  • Analytical & Strategic Thinking: strong analytical skills to synthesize complex information, identify key insights, and recommend actionable strategies; ability to prioritize client objectives while balancing technical feasibility and business goals.
  • Team Collaboration & Cross-Functional Coordination: demonstrated ability to work effectively across multiple departments, managing internal communications as deals move from the funnel stage to the kickoff; capability to serve as a liaison, ensuring alignment and clarity among Sales, Engineering, and Recruiting teams.
  • Consultative Sales Experience: prior experience in a pre-sales, sales engineering, or technical consulting role, ideally within a digital software consultancy or similar environment; ability to quickly assess client needs and transform them into actionable insights and proposals.

PERKS AND BENEFITS

  • Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
  • Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
  • A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.

title: Business Partner
description:
SOBRE A POSIÇÃO

Buscamos um(a) Business Partner para atuar como elo entre cliente, gerente de projetos, equipe técnica e gestão interna.

O foco é garantir que requisitos sejam corretamente levantados, documentados, validados e entregues, mantendo alinhamento entre escopo formalizado, expectativa do cliente e execução técnica.

Esse papel é essencial para assegurar previsibilidade, qualidade e alinhamento na execução dos projetos, evitando desvios de escopo e retrabalho.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES

  • Levantar, especificar e documentar requisitos junto aos clientes, alinhados ao escopo e necessidades, de forma estruturada.
  • Formalizar requisitos e alinhar continuamente expectativa do cliente x escopo x execução técnica.
  • Participar de sprints e progress pulse junto ao time técnico, garantindo clareza sobre prioridades, status e bloqueios.
  • Validar internamente as entregas (homologação interna) frente aos requisitos levantados e ao escopo acordado.
  • Conduzir homologação externa com o cliente (apresentação e validação da entrega), sempre baseada no escopo, levantamento e especificação inicial.
  • Preparar formalizações de entregáveis e relatórios (com validação final do gerente).
  • Atuar como sentinela de escopo e qualidade: detectar e sinalizar desvios ao gerente de projetos.
  • Negociar prazos e expectativas em nível tático com clientes; conflitos de maior complexidade ou estratégicos são escalados ao gerente.
  • Garantir documentação de projeto (deck de gestão, cronograma macro, matriz de riscos, matriz de responsabilidades, status de backlog).
  • Consolidar dados de pipeline de projetos, prazos, throughput, retrabalho e CSAT.

INDICADORES DE SUCESSO (KPIs)

  • Qualidade e clareza dos requisitos levantados, refletida na ausência de gaps em homologação.
  • Percentual de entregas validadas sem retrabalho.
  • Percentual de entregas realizadas no prazo.
  • CSAT positivo dos clientes em relação ao processo de entrega e acompanhamento.
  • Projetos concluídos com documentação completa e aprovações forma lizadas.

REQUISITOS

  • Experiência comprovada em levantamento, análise e especificação de requisitos.
  • Noções de negócio a partir da análise de dados.
  • Habilidade em comunicação escrita e verbal.

title: Marketing Lead
description:
Overview

Job Description: At Phreesia, we’re transforming the patient intake process and driving better healthcare outcomes through innovative technology. We are seeking a Marketing Lead to support and accelerate our marketing initiatives across key B2B healthcare segments. This role is ideal for a proactive, curious, and adaptable marketer who thrives in a dynamic environment and is excited to help turn ideas into action.

As a Marketing Lead, you will take ownership of key marketing initiatives and act as a critical partner to the Marketing Manager. You’ll contribute meaningfully to strategic execution, bringing ideas to life, managing cross-functional efforts, and ensuring campaigns are delivered with efficiency and impact. This role is well-suited for someone who enjoys trying new things, is curious about continuous learning, embraces ambiguity, and leverages tools to streamline work and improve outcomes.

What You’ll Do

Support the marketing and go-to-market plan for your segment to generate demand, including:

  • Own and execute multi-channel marketing campaigns across digital, email, social, events, and other channels—focused on generating awareness, engagement, and pipeline growth
  • Partner closely with the Marketing Manager to bring campaign strategies to life with clarity, precision, and efficiency
  • Use tools such as Marketo, Google Analytics, ChatGPT, and Monday.com to drive process improvements, manage timelines, and deliver high-quality work at scale
  • Coordinate cross-functional collaboration with Product, Sales, Content, and Creative teams to develop compelling assets and messaging
  • Support project management from campaign planning through launch, measurement, and retrospective
  • Analyze campaign data to extract actionable insights and recommend improvements or optimizations
  • Contribute to campaign briefs, proposals, and performance recaps
  • Manage segment-specific partnerships and third-party relationships, including event planning and co-branded initiatives
  • Develop persona-based messaging and content tailored to the needs of diverse healthcare stakeholders
  • Deepen your understanding of Phreesia’s customer segments, solutions, and competitive landscape to serve as a go-to resource within the marketing team
  • Maintain awareness of U.S. healthcare industry trends, especially within single-specialty care models
  • Support voice-of-the-customer research to inform messaging, strategy, and positioning
  • Bring curiosity and a learning mindset—proactively testing new approaches and optimizing existing ones
  • Adapt and pivot quickly as goals and priorities shift in a fast-paced environment

What You’ll Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in marketing, preferably in B2B SaaS, healthcare, or a related field
  • Proven ability to lead and manage projects involving multiple stakeholders and tight timelines
  • Demonstrated experience with campaign execution, performance tracking, and optimization across channels
  • A flexible and curious mindset—excited to try new tools, refine workflows, and solve problems creatively
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an ability to craft clear, compelling messaging
  • Strong attention to detail, ensuring quality and accuracy across campaign planning, execution, and reporting
  • Analytical thinking with experience using data to inform decisions and improve performance
  • Comfortable working independently and collaboratively within a cross-functional team
  • Familiarity with U.S. healthcare industry trends and how they affect provider organizations, particularly in single-specialty segments
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity with confidence, prioritize effectively, and stay focused in a dynamic environment
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Excel, Word), with working knowledge of ChatGPT
  • Availability to travel occasionally for in-person team meetings when appropriate

Compensation and Location

Base pay for the US is $75,000 - $90,000, depending on qualifications. In addition, Phreesia also offers equity as part of an attractive Total Rewards package.

Phreesia is a fully remote company; however, candidates located in ET and CT regions are given priority in the hiring process.

At Phreesia, we’re looking for smart and passionate people to help drive our mission of creating a better, more engaging healthcare experience.
